# Heavy / campaign tools — A100 strongly recommended; free T4 = small fallback only.
# Install on Colab (Pro/A100) in the sessions that actually run the models. Pin what you used.
# These PRODUCE the metrics the shared filter scores + the ON/OFF proxies; the filter itself needs none.
#   BindCraft        https://github.com/martinpacesa/BindCraft       # one-shot binder hallucination (A100). Pin a commit.
#   FreeBindCraft    https://github.com/cytokineking/FreeBindCraft    # free-tier fallback (VERIFY it still exists). Pin a commit.
#   RFdiffusion      https://github.com/RosettaCommons/RFdiffusion    # binder mode + scaffold/switch generation (A100). Pin a commit.
#   ColabDesign      https://github.com/sokrypton/ColabDesign         # RFdiffusion-binder + ProteinMPNN protocol. Pin a commit.
#   ColabFold        https://github.com/sokrypton/ColabFold           # AF2-Multimer (pae_interaction) + two-state modeling. Pin a commit.
# Switch / split-reporter design is LITERATURE-DRIVEN (no single package): adapt published LOCKR cages
# (Langan 2019) / de novo biosensors (Quijano-Rubio 2021) / NanoBiT split-luciferase (Dixon 2016).
# Optional stretch:
#   pyrosetta        # interface energy (rosetta_dG) / shape complementarity — academic license; FreeBindCraft avoids it. Pin the release.
